ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Satellite

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the NVS-03 satellite using the GSLV-F18 rocket. Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy congratulated ISRO scientists and engineers on the successful launch. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also extended his congratulations to ISRO for the successful mission.
